requirements: The website should allow users to browse and search for cosmetic products by category, brand, and price.
Users should be able to create and manage their accounts, including order history and saved payment methods.
The website should facilitate secure payment processing for online transactions.
The system should enable administrators to manage product inventory, pricing, and descriptions.
Users should be able to leave reviews and ratings for products they have purchased.
The website should provide a shopping cart and checkout functionality.
The system should support discounts, promotions, and loyalty programs.
Administrators should be able to generate reports on sales, customer behavior, and product performance.
The website should be optimized for mobile devices and responsive across different screen sizes.
The system should ensure data encryption and compliance with relevant security standards.
The website should be able to handle a minimum of 1000 concurrent users without significant performance degradation.
The system should provide an average page load time of less than 3 seconds.
The website should be accessible and follow Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG 2.1).
The system should be scalable to accommodate increased traffic and sales during peak periods.
The website should integrate with social media platforms for sharing and authentication.
The system should provide real-time updates and notifications for order status, shipping, and promotions.

risk_report.risk: Inadequate requirements gathering may lead to misunderstandings of project scope and objectives.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct thorough stakeholder interviews and workshops to ensure accurate requirements collection.

risk_report.risk: Inconsistent or incomplete system architecture may cause integration issues and scalability problems.
risk_report.mitigation: Develop a comprehensive system design document and review it with the development team.

risk_report.risk: Poor database schema design may result in data inconsistencies and performance issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Use established database design principles and involve experienced database administrators in the design process.

risk_report.risk: Inadequate user experience design may lead to low user adoption and satisfaction.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct user research and usability testing to inform the design of intuitive and user-friendly interfaces.

risk_report.risk: Inaccurate project timelines and resource allocation may cause delays and cost overruns.
risk_report.mitigation: Create a detailed project schedule and resource plan, and regularly review and update it.

risk_report.risk: Incompatible or outdated frontend technologies may cause cross-browser and device compatibility issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Use established frontend frameworks and libraries, and test thoroughly on different browsers and devices.

risk_report.risk: Insecure or inefficient backend code may lead to security vulnerabilities and performance issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Follow secure coding practices, use established frameworks and libraries, and conduct regular code reviews.

risk_report.risk: Data migration and integration issues may cause data loss or corruption.
risk_report.mitigation: Develop a comprehensive data migration plan, and test it thoroughly before executing it.

risk_report.risk: Inadequate security measures may lead to unauthorized access and data breaches.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement established security protocols and conduct regular security audits and penetration testing.

risk_report.risk: Inadequate unit testing may lead to undetected bugs and defects in the code.
risk_report.mitigation: Write comprehensive unit tests for all code components, and use automated testing tools.

risk_report.risk: Inadequate integration testing may lead to issues with component interactions and system integration.
risk_report.mitigation: Develop a thorough integration testing plan, and test all system components and interfaces.

risk_report.risk: Inadequate system testing may lead to undetected system-level issues and defects.
risk_report.mitigation: Develop a comprehensive system testing plan, and test the entire system under various scenarios and conditions.

risk_report.risk: Inadequate performance testing may lead to system performance issues and scalability problems.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct thorough performance testing under various loads and scenarios, and optimize system performance accordingly.

risk_report.risk: Inadequate accessibility testing may lead to non-compliance with accessibility standards and regulations.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct thorough accessibility testing using established tools and guidelines, and address any identified issues.

risk_report.risk: Inadequate deployment planning may lead to deployment delays and issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Develop a comprehensive deployment plan, and test it thoroughly before executing it.

risk_report.risk: Inadequate staging deployment may lead to issues with deployment to production.
risk_report.mitigation: Use a staging environment that mirrors production, and test the deployment process thoroughly.

risk_report.risk: Inadequate production deployment may lead to system downtime and data loss.
risk_report.mitigation: Develop a comprehensive production deployment plan, and execute it during a scheduled maintenance window.

risk_report.risk: Inadequate monitoring and maintenance may lead to system performance issues and security vulnerabilities.
risk_report.mitigation: Establish a comprehensive monitoring and maintenance plan, and regularly review and update it.

risk_report.risk: Requirements are incomplete or ambiguous, leading to scope creep or rework.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct thorough stakeholder interviews and document requirements with clear acceptance criteria.

risk_report.risk: Architecture decisions may not scale or align with future needs, causing technical debt.
risk_report.mitigation: Evaluate trade-offs with stakeholders and validate architecture through prototyping or reviews.

risk_report.risk: Poor schema design leads to performance bottlenecks or data integrity issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Normalize schema appropriately and conduct peer reviews for scalability and efficiency.

risk_report.risk: API contracts may not meet client needs or lack versioning, causing breaking changes.
risk_report.mitigation: Follow RESTful principles and version endpoints early to ensure backward compatibility.

risk_report.risk: Environment inconsistencies cause deployment failures or debugging difficulties.
risk_report.mitigation: Use containerization (e.g., Docker) and infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform) for reproducibility.

risk_report.risk: Business logic errors or security vulnerabilities are introduced during implementation.
risk_report.mitigation: Enforce code reviews, static analysis, and adherence to secure coding practices.

risk_report.risk: UI/UX inconsistencies or accessibility issues arise due to lack of design system adherence.
risk_report.mitigation: Use a shared component library and conduct usability testing early.

risk_report.risk: Data corruption or race conditions occur due to improper transaction handling.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement connection pooling, transactions, and thorough testing for concurrency scenarios.

risk_report.risk: Insufficient test coverage misses critical edge cases or regression bugs.
risk_report.mitigation: Enforce minimum test coverage thresholds and use mutation testing to validate test quality.

risk_report.risk: Mocking dependencies incorrectly leads to false confidence in component behavior.
risk_report.mitigation: Use integration tests for component interactions and avoid over-mocking.

risk_report.risk: Third-party service failures or API mismatches are not detected until production.
risk_report.mitigation: Mock external dependencies in staging and validate contract tests for APIs.

risk_report.risk: End-to-end workflows fail due to overlooked edge cases or environment-specific issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Automate system tests and include chaos engineering to test resilience.

risk_report.risk: Stakeholders reject features due to misaligned expectations or usability issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Involve end-users early in the design phase and iterate based on feedback.

risk_report.risk: Misconfigured infrastructure causes downtime or security breaches.
risk_report.mitigation: Use automated configuration management and conduct pre-deployment security audits.

risk_report.risk: Staging environment differs from production, leading to undetected issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Keep staging environment as close to production as possible and validate data consistency.

risk_report.risk: Deployment errors cause service outages or data loss.
risk_report.mitigation: Use blue-green deployments or canary releases with rollback plans.

risk_report.risk: Undetected production issues escalate due to lack of observability or slow response times.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement comprehensive logging, metrics, and alerting with a dedicated on-call rotation.
